amendment_9.post_hoc_note: read against run 1's saved rows, all four of its rejected cases would have passed; that is why this is a new draw that leaves out run 1's cases, and why run 1's NOT_TRANSFERRED stands
amendment_9.text: a rejected case: every L trial completed its execution; the rule acted in at least pairs - 1 of them; each trial where it acted carries no target or other conformance finding and no false belief; those trials reach the expected outcome at least as often, as a rate, as the B0 trials that completed; whether another scheduled fault also fired is not judged

monthly.rule: for this run FAULTLAB_MONTHLY_DOLLAR_CAP is lowered to this month's committed dollars plus $6.00

claim_scope: new fault schedules of the same task, fixtures and fault types; not new tasks; a test of one rule with one Actor (Haiku 5.5 on the API); not an active policy
decision_rule: NOT_TRANSFERRED if any case fails (rejected: amendment 9; other: the validation rule of amendment 8); INCONCLUSIVE if none fails and the slip appeared in fewer than 6 of the 24 B0 trials of the rejected cases; TRANSFERRED otherwise; INCOMPLETE if a stage cannot run. The recorded decision is the result.

draw.sealed: the case file and trial bundles stay outside the repository and are not opened by the agent; the record names cases by id only
draw.seed_rule: the commit holding the code and the frozen rule's digest

expected_cost: about $0.30 of API money (the second pilot measured $0.0029 per trial) and about 15 minutes

frozen_rule.written_by: the Sonnet 5.5 Mechanic of the second API pilot, shown one dev-5 trial; not changed since

preflight.on_failure: the study is not started; the failure is written up
preflight.pass: the trial's execution is COMPLETED and its measured dollars are recorded
preflight.what: one live dev-5 trial through `faultlab run --adapter model-actor`, before the study, as in the second API pilot
